classification_status: provisional assistant coding; human reliability absent

cases.required_property: A produceMore event between yield and stopProducing must remain observable.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: count notifications and validate generation at handoff
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Counter is evidence of intervening history; a locked snapshot alone did not retain it.

cases.required_property: Producer completion after an early response/pause must be a valid protocol transition.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: accept completion after early response and pending pause
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Repair admits a legal event order; not a cancellation-latch example.

cases.required_property: Every retained signal source must reach cancellation cleanup, including cancelled initialization.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: retain cleanup ownership; cancel sources and activate cleanup
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Cancellation must be accompanied by activation where DispatchSource cleanup requires it.

cases.required_property: Connection close must complete each pending request/response continuation state.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: resume all pending states on connection close
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Missing terminal branch, not proven early-registration loss.

cases.required_property: Completion/cancellation must obtain one exclusive callback batch.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: atomically remove and return callback batch
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Lock the remove-and-return claim, not separate reads and removal.

cases.required_property: Competing completions must claim a continuation at most once; setup cancellation also needs handling.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: early cancellation checks and actor-guarded once-only resumption
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Actor-backed once-only claim addresses a different property from later task-attachment cancellation delivery.

cases.required_property: Dependency failure/disposal must revoke pending work and reject late outputs.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: cancel orphan work and guard disposed state before early return
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Compound lifecycle family: cancel orphan work and move the guard before the early-return path.

cases.required_property: Cancellation must observe the subsequently installed subscription rather than a captured nil value.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: share reference to subsequently installed subscription
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Reference sharing repairs stale capture; it does not prove cancellation-before-installation is latched.

cases.required_property: Starting observation must revalidate cancellation at the protected fetch/use point.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: revalidate under fetch lock and return cancelled result
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Legacy check/use repair, not actor reentrancy.

cases.required_property: A cancelled request must not re-enter retry admission.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: guard cancellation before invoking retry flow
cases.interpretation_and_limit: State admission guard; no proof of cancellation halting every in-flight action.

cases.required_property: Every transition of the prefetch task set to empty must publish completion.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: derive completion from transition of task set to empty
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Centralize notification on the transition; unrelated all-cached allegation remains outside the supported defect.

cases.required_property: All accesses to shared throttle dictionaries must use the same synchronization domain.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: recursive lock around all throttle dictionary accesses; scheduler delivery
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Ordinary shared-state synchronization, contrary to an all-handoff interpretation.

cases.required_property: A serialized writer must not wait for a reader held by observations waiting for that writer.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: asynchronous coalesced fetch without blocking writer for reader
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Remove blocking dependency and represent coalesced asynchronous fetch state.

cases.required_property: Constraint rebuilding must occur at intentional lifecycle points rather than compete with animation updates.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: rebuild header constraints only at deliberate setup/location changes
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Event-phase ownership rather than a new mutex; UI event-race stratum.

cases.required_property: One owner must consume remote commands across app and extension.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: single-owner polling; extension only signals pending command
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Centralize consumption; per-process locking would not by itself establish this ownership rule.

cases.required_property: Render flags and draw work must be confined to the same queue.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: serialize all draw work on private mpvGLQueue
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Queue confinement; reporter-supplied TSan evidence is distinct from our execution.

cases.required_property: Window callbacks must reject mpv access after closing/shutdown begins.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: guard all affected window-state and resize entry points with closing state
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Late callback guards, not continuation registration.

cases.required_property: Compound logger lookup/insertion and UI iteration must be mutually protected.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: lock compound subsystem lookup/insertion and UI iteration
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Atomic container access alone is not the full compound critical section.

cases.required_property: Render teardown and display/draw/swap callbacks must share lifecycle synchronization.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: shared lifecycle lock across uninit, display, draw and swap reporting
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Compound lifecycle repair; bundled workaround regression is not a separate counted root.

cases.required_property: Output EOF with input already closed must close the channel and its terminal future.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: close full channel when writeEOF observes input already closed
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Close the missing combined terminal state; no native task endpoint is required.

cases.required_property: New I/O work must wake the platform poll rather than wait for unrelated traffic.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: socket-pair wakeup integrated with WSAPoll
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Wakeup mechanism must match platform blocking semantics; immature Windows stratum.

cases.required_property: Synchronous cache lookup must not wait behind a long directory scan on the coordination queue.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: move expensive scan off state-coordination queue; publish snapshot briefly
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Move expensive work out and publish the snapshot briefly; not a deadlock proof.

cases.required_property: Home-model refresh and UI/privacy notifications must use compatible execution confinement.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: remove global-queue refresh and execute on caller main-thread path
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Moderate source confidence; no public crash stack in the saved packet.

cases.required_property: mpv rendering must use its creation OpenGL context as current on each caller and coordinate its use.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: retain renderer context; lock and set it on each calling thread
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Thread affinity plus synchronization; pre-merge proposed lock inversion is not a shipped regression.

cases.required_property: Only one runtime may own process-wide invocation consumption while running.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: atomic compare-exchange run gate released with defer
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Process-wide atomic admission and defer release, not prohibition of multiple constructed instances.

cases.required_property: Startup failure must reach both existing and subsequently registered address waiters.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: retain startup error and resolve both existing and late waiters
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Retain terminal failure; does not alone solve waiter cardinality or server identity.

cases.required_property: Run and wait must share server identity, and each concurrent waiter must remain owned.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: cache one server instance and retain all address waiters
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Cache server identity and retain all waiters; compound family, not two independent observations.

cases.required_property: An immediate subscription must observe a terminal event even if registration reaches the actor later.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: retain/replay terminal result when registering late event stream
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Retain/replay terminal outcome; native-to-native handoff, not legacy bridge.

cases.required_property: Cancelled/superseded cache work must be rejected at disk/decode/publication checkpoints.
cases.recorded_fix_pattern: thread-safe cancellation token, checkpoint revalidation and stale outcome propagation
cases.interpretation_and_limit: Cancellation token propagates staleness beyond a network DownloadTask; does not guarantee immediate physical I/O termination.
